sources.snippet: The model outperforms Claude-4.6-Opus (Max) at agentic coding, vision, and chat. We are working very hard to support the model and thank you Qwen for day zero access. Run Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Guide Download Unsloth We are still working on supporting the model, please wait for us!

sources.title: Qwen3.8 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Run Qwen3.8 Guide You can now run Qwen3.8 in llama.cpp and Unsloth Desktop. For the large Qwen3.8-2.T model, we will be utilizing the 397GB IQ1_XXXS quant (named Q1_0) for best results in terms of accessibility and accuracy and it will require at least 450GB RAM. Feel free to change quantization type.
